values: Alper Ferudun, Essential Self-Adjointness of the Laplace–Beltrami Operator for a Family of Non-Regular Almost-Riemannian Structures,29Sep2026,v1.0,unrefereed existing preprint; concept DOI10.5281/zenodo.23041945. Resolves the concrete all-ell question under the explicitly cited PRS Example7.7 complete-family interpretation: both PRS torus Examples7.7–7.8 are essentially self-adjoint for every n>=2,integer ell>=1. Also covers smooth c(z)x(x^(2ell)+rho(z)) on R times R/circle,ell>=0,c>0,rho>=0,sup c and sup(c rho) finite. The literal entire polynomial plane instead is not essentially self-adjoint for every ell>=1, through a nonzero adjoint boundary form at infinity. Original Rizzi OWR47/2019 pp2919–2921 assumes ambient completeness, incompatible with that literal plane; the negative result is not a counterexample in the complete setting. No arbitrary complete-local-extension theorem or broader real-analytic no-tangency conjecture resolution claimed. Hardy/Agmon input of Prandi–Rizzi–Seri and Franceschi–Prandi–Rizzi credited. Required correction: older effective-potential criterion range is n=2:ell=1; n>=3:ell<=n, when f0 has both zero and positive values. PRS remainder-path/determinant cautions retained. Fresh full primary proof and publication-file/ZIP-CRC review supports these exact results, not the manuscript wholesale, numerical certificates, novelty or worldwide priority. This independent review is AI-assisted,unrefereed,no external human peer review/formal certification. https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1236 ; https://eulersolve.org/papers/owr-17290-002/
